footer.disclaimer: NAP Store verifies technical signal parameters. It is not a medical service: neither the frequencies in a file nor a session guarantee any brain state or therapeutic result.
footer.methods: The converter is our own two-carrier generator. Published approaches of The Monroe Institute and the Center for Neuroacoustic Research served as methodological references; there is no licence, partnership or access to proprietary algorithms.
